Mona

​It's heartbreaking to be arbitrarily shut out of my child's life by his school, and their customer service response was appalling. Avoid this school if you are a co-parent.

featured_reviews.review_text: What I like about Safari Kid Preschool & Daycare is that it’s not just studies all the time. There’s a good mix of activities, play, and learning. featured_reviews.name: Varun Madan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Exceptional Early Childhood Development at Safari Kid

Nestled in the charming lanes of Pali Hill, Bandra, this school is meticulously designed to cater to every aspect of a child's development. From the well-planned classrooms to the inviting play areas, every detail reflects thoughtful consideration. The teachers here are nothing short of amazing; they go above and beyond to meet each child's needs.

One of the standout features of Safari Kid is its emphasis on experiential learning. From exciting field trips to nature parks, fire stations, and even airports, the school provides enriching experiences that leave a lasting impact on young minds. Moreover, kids are introduced to people from various service sectors, ranging from doctors and postmen to vegetable sellers. These interactions broaden their horizons and foster a deeper understanding of the world around them.

I witnessed the remarkable transformation of my 2-year-old during her time at Safari Kid. From being initially hesitant and tearful, she blossomed into a confident performer, captivating the audience at the school's annual day.

While ABCs and 123s are taught everywhere, Safari Kid stands out for its comprehensive approach to learning. My child's progress has been astounding – she now communicates clearly, exhibits independence in getting ready, has developed healthier eating habits, and interacts confidently with peers and adults alike.

I am deeply grateful to the entire team at Safari Kid, especially Nishka, the principal, and the dedicated class teachers, Mansha, and Avantika. Your guidance and support have made a profound impact on my child's journey.

I wholeheartedly recommend this school to all parents seeking a nurturing environment for their little ones.
Thank you, Safari Kid!

featured_reviews.review_text:

Their ability to handle conflicts with such calmness and patience, and their consistent encouragement for children to use their words and express themselves, is something we value greatly.
Overall the management is good.

featured_reviews.name: Benaisha Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text: Admitting my 2 boys to Little Hearts Preschool was the best decision for their strong foundation in education. The school environment is extremely welcoming, inclusive, warm and enthusiastic. The entire school staff is wonderful, loving and caring with the children. The teachers take efforts to give individual attention to each child, identify their areas of interest, strong points and work on their areas on improvement. Special thanks to Meher ma’am, Binaifer ma’am, Parveen ma’am, Manju ma’am for all their help and insights …Their approach to teaching is wholesome - a mix of fun filled activities, story telling, songs, field trips to reinforce the traditional methods. In addition to the standard curriculum, it is lovely to see other areas of focus such as sports, various festivals celebration along with understanding their genesis and customs. My boys really blossomed in their 2 years here, thoroughly enjoyed their time here and was a second home to them. I would like to specially mention the fantastic annual days the teachers and students put up… all kids participate and are super excited to be on stage.. kudos to the efforts and patience put in by the teachers .. overall Little Hearts has been amazing experience for us!!!
